questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I:** Some A are B.

**Statement II:** Some B are K.

**Statement III:** All K are J.

**Conclusion I:** Some B are J.

**Conclusion II:** Some A are J.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
**Given Statements:**

Some A are B.

Some B are K.

All K are J.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/634f05719cdefc338e421fc385ceeb9969a08450558eaa49ff60bb273927939d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d00f74460e7a3b72f2512e94734ba69212f598165b76dbc3a2e1efb9ff1dab3a.png] 

Conclusion 

I: Some B are J. - **True **(Because, Some B are K and All K are J, so, Some B are also J)

II: Some A are J. - **False **(Because, there is no direct relation given between A and J, so it can be possible)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion I follows".**

questions.question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

4 and 7
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] 

Given: 4 and 7

Option 1) 4 × 2 + 7 - 3 = 15

After interchanging the numbers:

⇒ __**7 × 2**__ + 4 - 3 = 15

⇒ __14____** + 4**__ - 3 = 15

⇒ __18____** - 3**__ = 15

⇒ 15 = 15

**Option 2) 4 ÷ 2 + 3 + 7 = 6**

After interchanging the numbers:

⇒ __**7 ÷ 2**__ + 3 + 4 = 6

⇒ __3.5____** + 3 + 4**__ = 6

⇒ 10.5 = 6

This equation will be not correct.

Option 3) 7 - 4 + 9 = 6

After interchanging the numbers:

⇒ __**4**__ - 7 __**+ 9**__ = 6

⇒ __**13 - 7**__ = 6

⇒ 6 = 6

Option 4) 7 + 2 - 4 × 3 = -15

After interchanging the numbers:

⇒ 4 + 2 - __**7 × 3**__ = -15

⇒ __**4 + 2**__ - 21 = -15

⇒ __**6 - 21**__ = -15

⇒ -15 = -15

Hence, the correct answer is **"4 ÷ 2 + 3 + 7 = 6".**

Given: P ÷ D $ B + H × T - M

It means: P is the mother of D, D is the brother of B, B is the wife of H, H is the father of T and T is the sister of M.

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

10 - 26 + 12 × 20 ÷ 5 = 18
In a certain code language, if SIXTEEN is coded as '10', NINE is coded as '7', then what will 'EIGHT' be coded as?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c8f33eed1ccff5a91943e768984fbd3c4f61783aec1860938bf77c020091b1f.png] 

The logic followed here is:** Number of letters in the word + 3 = Number code.**

SIXTEEN is coded as '10',

Letters in SIXTEEN = 7, then 7 + 3 = 10

NINE is coded as '7',

Letter in NINE = 4, then 4 + 3 = 7

Similarly, **'EIGHT' will be coded: **

**Letters in EIGHT = 5, then 5 + 3 = 8**

Hence, the correct answer is **"8".**
